text: Until the sources name them, the customer other-products harness is assumed to run from one harness repository in SIT for the run of record and in UAT for the acceptance run against the published contracts, to seed case "RW-2026-000410" with borrower "C-0410" and account "A-0410", the products "A-0411" with status "ACTIVE" and "A-0412" with status "DELINQUENT" with data as of 2026-12-14 and the stale copy of 2026-12-13, the masked account number "9900015678" and the role, scope and masking rule rows, and case "RW-2026-000420" with borrower "C-0420", through the owning contracts or the section 12.8 fakes; to publish one evidence report per story and business date with one row per criterion, seam, answering service or fake, observed value and result, retained with the release record; to pass only when every owned criterion is green with the three I stories in place; and to read the other-products panel through one gateway-bff composite case-record route that composes the rwb-integration answer, the rwb-case facts and the rwb-access session in one gateway answer. The missing field IDs are assumed to describe the entities named in section 11 and to change no assertion of section 7.
why: The story needs a repository, two environments, a seeding order, an evidence artefact, a gate and a composite route to be testable and repeatable, and no source gives any of them; the legacy story predates the split into services and names none of the target artefacts, and the legacy Data section lists no field ID for the rwb_access masking rule, the rwb_case reference rows or the rwb_source_data freshness tables.
read: Read as test-only defaults that change no production behaviour: the harness calls only the owning services and their fakes, owns no table, endpoints, screen, workflow or schedule, writes nothing into rwb_source_data, rwb_integration, rwb_case or rwb_access, and reads the ACE views never at all, because only rwb-source-data holds that grant (DP-05); the composite route is the DP-19 gateway answer and not a call from the browser to each service.
applied_in: 3 Preconditions; 11 Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes; 13 Solution plan (environment and test data, build steps, done when); 15 Screens and states
confirm: The integration lead and QA lead confirm the repository, the environments, the seeding order, the evidence format and retention and the gate before the UAT run; the platform edge owner confirms the composite case-record route path and merge order before the panel assertions are run; the data dictionary owner confirms the field IDs at the next version.
impact: Low: the criteria, the legacy values, the messages, the tables, the operations and their owners are fixed; only the harness packaging, the evidence artefact, the gate, the composite route detail and some field IDs move, and no production story is blocked by the assumption.
